specs.title: the Tune fields accept multi-character typing (no reformat-while-typing clobber)
v-expo-step fields keep clean decimals while spinning (grid-aligned step)
NumInput spinner keeps fixed decimal places (no compounding float precision)

class-level: NO Original-skin spinner gains decimal places while spinning (all fields, all box types)
Original save buttons sit in a right-edge rail beside the tabs (no vertical space consumed)
field constraints: negative/out-of-range entry is rejected or clamped everywhere (schema-enforced)
Signal tab: Series resistance shows WinISD 3-dp precision (0.100 ohm)
Signal tab: Driver input voltage is editable and drives System input power (W↔V, P=V²/Re)
Original skin buttons have readable dark text on their light fill
New Project collects the project name first and shows it in the titlebar
New Project starts fresh — it discards the previous design (filters, compare, params)
the New Project wizard sets box type + volume then opens the driver picker
Original toolbar: Share link (Export menu) writes the design into the address bar
a pinned graph cursor survives the share link — opening it shows the same marker
a dragged frequency band selection survives the share link
the Save bar tracks modified state; Save adopts it, Reset reverts it (STATE_MODEL ground↔modified)
the chosen skin is remembered across a reload (local preference)
Driver pane: WinISD-parity added-mass field feeds the engine model (g→kg, resonance drops)
Driver Editor decimals come from the registry (Vas 2 dp, Sd 1 dp)
R1: an open Driver Editor is reopened after a reload

R1 refresh fidelity: box type, active tab, and selected chart survive a reload
clicking an entered field's unit label rescales the DISPLAY and keeps the model SI
a calculated readout also rescales when its unit is rotated (Hz → kHz)
Added mass to cone: clicking the unit converts g → kg; the model stays SI (kg)
Advanced Temperature: K → °C converts via OFFSET; the model stays in kelvin
Voice coil temp rise, resistance TC, and added mass all convert (no runaway precision)

Original skin: Options → General → Environment default seeds a fresh mount's Advanced-pane Temperature (not a hardcoded literal)
